name: Fluted
author: Emilie Gillet
description: A jet flute derived from Braids' FLUT: a bore and a jet delay line sharing one loop, driven by an asymmetric cubic jet and a breath the noise multiplies. It overblows into a higher register, as the module does.

controls.label: Embouchure
controls.description: Braids' COLOR: splits one fixed loop length between jet and bore. Moves the embouchure without moving the pitch.

controls.label: Air
controls.description: Braids' TIMBRE: breath turbulence, 51% depth down to 1%. Backwards, as the module's is: low airy, high steady.

controls.label: Blow
controls.description: Breath pressure, welded at twice the envelope in Braids. Under- or over-blow the pipe until it changes register.

controls.label: Body
controls.description: The bore's damping, which Braids ties rigidly to the note and gives no knob. Down for a dark pipe, up for a bright one.

outputs.main: The bore pressure at the far end, which is what the module emits.
outputs.aux: A second tap halfway along the same bore, level-matched but decorrelated. The stereo toggle does not change this fixed two-pickup pair.

trigger: Restarts the excitation envelope, flushes both delay lines and clears the reflection filter.
